rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa, varṇa, rāśi, and stha; situated in the forehead syllable mass
numeral lakṣa in accusative singular neuter
absolutive form of the root kṛ
compound of sura and arcita; vocative address to the god-worshipped one

items.question: What action follows after the forehead syllable mass has been worshipped by gods?
premises: hundred thousand is to be done
items.inference: The verse prescribes performing one hundred thousand after the god-worshipped forehead syllable mass.
uncertainties: exact referent of kṛtya is unclear
syntactic role of lakṣaṃ is uncertain
items.plain_english: After the forehead syllable mass worshipped by gods, one hundred thousand acts are to be done.
